description: This PHP class, WorkShiftDetailedModel, is part of the OrangeHRM system. It models detailed information about a work shift, including properties like id, name, hours per day, start and end times, and associated employees. The class implements normalization for API responses and interacts with services and data access objects to obtain related employee data.

classes.name: WorkShiftDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that provides detailed information about a work shift for API responses, including associated employees, with normalization capabilities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an associative array representing the detailed work shift information, including id, name, hours per day, start and end times formatted as strings, and a list of normalized employee models.
